At midday close China's main futures front-month contracts were mixed. Palladium rose over 8%, platinum over 7%, Shanghai silver nearly 6%, Shanghai nickel over 5%, Shanghai gold over 4%, red dates almost 4%, and coke and lithium carbonate rose more than 3%.
